tools.name: generate_npvt
tools.description: Generate a valid encrypted NPVT1 container (.npvt file content) for NapsternetV / NPV Tunnel (iOS & Android) from VLESS/VMess parameters.

tools.name: decode_npvt
tools.description: Decrypt and parse an NPVT1 string or .npvt file back to human-readable VLESS/VMess profiles and settings.

tools.description: Retrieve stored Cloudflare account IDs, active API token, D1 database ID, and worker endpoints so they are never lost.
